rotationGuidance.scenario: Level 60, one level-63 target, 300 seconds, attacking from behind with the measured gear, buffs and consumes.
rotationGuidance.instruction: Check this list from the top. Use the first available action whose conditions hold, then start again at the top. If an action is unavailable, continue to the next priority.
priorities: Use Thistle Tea when available if your energy is at most 10.
Use Slice and Dice when available if your combo points are at least 1 and Slice and Dice is not active and the fight has at least 6 seconds remaining.
Use Slice and Dice when available if your combo points are at least 5 and Slice and Dice is active and Slice and Dice has at most 2 seconds remaining and the fight has at least 6 seconds remaining.
Use other enabled cooldowns when available.
Use Vanish when available if Stealth is not active and your combo points are at most 1 and your energy is at least 60 and Slice and Dice is active and the fight has at least 10 seconds remaining.
Use Premeditation when available if your combo points are at most 2.
Use Ambush when available if your combo points are at most 3.
Use Hemorrhage when available if the target is not affected by Hemorrhage and your combo points are at most 4 and Rupture is not active on the target and the fight has at least 10 seconds remaining.
Use Rupture when available if your combo points are at least 3 and Rupture is not active on the target and the fight has at least 10 seconds remaining.
Use Cold Blood when available if your combo points are at least 5 and Eviscerate can be cast.
Use Eviscerate when available if your combo points are at least 5.
Use Eviscerate when available if your combo points are at least 1 and the fight has at most 3 seconds remaining.
Use Ghostly Strike when available if your combo points are at most 3.
Use Hemorrhage when available if your combo points are at most 4 and your energy is at least 60.

A statistically better tiny contender stays disclosed; a material gap/large uncertainty refuses acceptance. This is not a simultaneous confidence bound, mathematical95% optimum or live-server validation. Do not choose a replacement from holdouts; selected native/WASM/browser/default/guide delivery is still required.
evaluation.applicabilityScope: Unchanged actual selected state retains applicability to the capped two-sweep gear evidence, not global convergence.
